structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a stylish fashion studio building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant dress form and a spool of thread on its roof.
character: young fashion intern (a Black man in his early 20s, short twists, oversized denim jacket, a pin cushion on his wrist)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and steams garments hanging on a long clothing rail.
he pins fabric swatches and sketches onto a large trend board.
he measures a sample garment at a cutting table against a spec sheet of abstract lines, tape measure in hand.
he dresses a mannequin for a product photo, a small camera on a tripod nearby.
he packs garments into plain boxes and garment bags ready to send, a tidy rail behind him; dusk through the window.
props: a giant spool of thread, scissors, a sewing needle, a tape measure, coat hangers, a sewing machine, buttons
